items.name: Boysenberry hand pie
items.description: A warm single-serving pie filled with the farm's signature boysenberry — the founding flavor in walkable form.
items.verdict: The single most on-brand food item at any park on this site. Buy one, eat it in Ghost Town, understand the whole farm.

items.name: Boysenberry punch
items.description: Boysenberry punch — the drinkable version of the berry that named the farm, sold by the cup and the souvenir glass.
items.verdict: Sweet, tart, and cheaper than a funnel cake with more identity per ounce. The correct coaster-queue companion.

items.name: Fried chicken dinner
items.description: The 1927 original: fried chicken with mashed potatoes, gravy and biscuits — the dinner whose waiting queue invented the American theme park.
items.verdict: A genuine institution and the best full meal associated with any park on this site. Reserve, order the pie after, and understand why the ghost town exists.

items.name: Boysenberry pie
items.description: The farm's signature berry in pie form, served at the restaurant that started everything.
items.verdict: Order it first if the table is smart. The boysenberry is the reason there is a park at all, and this is its canonical expression.
